richiami.difetto: A faulty internal restrictor valve may cause excess pressure in the vehicle's tipping system. This could cause structeral failure of the body lifting cylinder and result in uncontrolled descent of the body.
richiami.rimedio: Check the security of the  restrictor in the PT valve. Tighten if necessary and lock the thread in accordance with the Hyva technical bulletin. Damaged valves are to be replaced as directed.
richiami.titolo: TIPPING BODY SYSTEM RESTRICTOR VALVE MAY FAIL
